sections.title: The same form, rewritten
body: Labels, bindings, validation, loading states, dirty tracking: every form repeats the same work, and every copy drifts a little.

sections.title: Data and schema in, form out
body: FormRenderer takes your data and, optionally, a JSON-schema-like description. Types map to inputs (a string with format email becomes an email field), layout is a separate description, and lookups load options for selects.
points: Schema derived from data when you have none
Validation on blur, dirty state tracked

sections.title: Built from the same components
body: Form inputs are built on the same Rokkit components as the rest of the UI, so they theme and behave the same way.

sections.title: The Rokkit idea
body: Bind data as it is, map fields instead of reshaping, keep a strict architecture, and let themes do the styling. Next week: Kavach, authentication for SvelteKit.
